name: Privatzimmer Barbara
beschreibung: Privatzimmer Barbara is an inn in Ebbs, a village in the Tiroler Unterland near the border with Bayern. The building is quietly located on the edge of the village, surrounded by meadows and with easy access to the Kaisergebirge. Guests can expect classic Tiroler hospitality, simple, clean rooms, and a restaurant serving regional cuisine. The location is ideal for hikers and nature lovers who want to explore the surrounding area.
